[[Zoldark's Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] obtained from the treasure chest after defeating [[Zoldark The Unholy]] in [[Vloxen Excavations]].

==Stats==
:Energy +12 (requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Energy]] [[regeneration]] - 1

==Skin==
*This item uses [[Bone Charm]] skin.

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated as it effectively has two inscriptions:
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Live for Today]]" inscription
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Serenity Now]]" inscription
